items_all.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items_all.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.summary: MiniMax released MiniMax-Music3, an open-weights text-to-music model. items_all.title: OpenAI signs record Ohio data center lease with Nvidia backing up to $105 billion
items_all.summary: OpenAI has signed a 20-year lease for an 8-gigawatt data center in Ohio. Nvidia is guaranteeing up to $105 billion for the residual value of the facilities and becomes the exclusive chip supplier. According to the Wall Street Journal, nine tech companies now hold around $3 trillion in AI commitments that don't appear on any balance sheet. The article OpenAI signs record Ohio data center lease with Nvidia backing up to $105 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 已簽署俄亥俄州一座 8 吉瓦資料中心的 20 年租約。 Nvidia 為這些設施的剩餘價值提供高達 1050 億美元的保證，併成為獨家晶片供應商。據《華爾街日報》報道，九家科技公司目前持有約 3 萬億美元的人工智慧承諾，但這些承諾並未出現在任何資產負債表上。文章 OpenAI 與 Nvidia 簽訂了創紀錄的俄亥俄州資料中心租賃合同，金額高達 1050 億美元，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
items_all.summary: AI production companies like Promise are setting up shop around Hollywood's historic studios, using real-time backgrounds and other AI tools to cut film costs. Netflix already uses AI in 300 of its 1,000 titles, and the startup Higgsfield now carries a $5.4 billion valuation. What was once a tech demo has grown into its own industry, complete with valuations, job titles, and fights over who gets a cut. The article AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.summary: Anthropic's text watermarking for Claude is supposed to make AI-generated content detectable. But critics doubt that word choice stays unaffected, and lawyers are facing new transparency headaches. The article Anthropic watermarks Claude's output, but critics question the tradeoffs appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Google允許用戶去除AI生成影音內容的浮水印、開源函式庫Credentio
items_all.summary: Google宣佈將讓使用者自行決定以Gemini生成的圖片、影片和音樂移除明顯的浮水印，但仍然保有機器可辨識的數位痕跡。Google同時開源用以開發內容驗證的C++函式庫Credentio。 使用者可在「設定」區中關閉「Show watermark（顯示浮水印）」設定，就能為所有Gemini模型生成的圖片、影片和音樂關閉可見的浮水印，但是人眼不可見的SynthID浮水印和C2PA meta仍然會保留嵌入於背景。Google將在未來幾天內部署這項新設定。

items_all.title: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items_all.summary: According to Bloomberg, Stripe is acquiring the AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, up from a latest valuation of $1.3 billion. OpenRouter offers access to over 400 AI models, has eight million users, and its CEO had described the company as "Stripe for AI." Now that's becoming a reality. The article Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 據彭博社報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter，高於最新估值 13 億美元。 OpenRouter 提供對 400 多種 AI 模型的訪問，擁有 800 萬使用者，其執行長將該公司描述為“AI 的 Stripe”。現在這正在成為現實。據報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: 不動產登記案件增、人力不足! 竹市導入AI協審半年處理逾2千案件，省下逾3萬分鐘工時
items_all.summary: 隨著不動產交易需求增加，地政事務所長期面臨案件量增加與審查人力不足的雙重壓力。過去土地登記案件多以紙本送件為主，審查人員需逐項核對身分證、印鑑證明、契約書及完稅資料等文件，在少子化及公務人力補充不易的環境下，如何利用科技提升行政審查效率，成為政府導入AI的重要應用場景。 以新竹市地政事務所為例，因竹科帶動的房地產交易需求增加，不動產登記案件量長期居全國單一地政事務所前幾名，以2025年辦理的不動產登記案件就多達16萬4,653筆之多，連續三年稱霸全國單一地政事務所冠軍。 若以買賣案件為例，審查人員每個案件需要跨文件核對至少約95個欄位，涉及多份紙本文件，過去主要仰賴承辦人員人工比對。

items_all.title: DeepSeek開源DeepSeek Harness，AI代理執行環境可拆成外掛自由組合
items_all.summary: DeepSeek開源AI代理執行框架DeepSeek Harness，目前以開發者預覽版提供使用。框架底層採用Cordis外掛（Plugin）系統，從AI模型、工具、技能、工作階段、沙箱、儲存、代理執行迴圈、排程到使用者介面，都能依需求更換或重新組合，開發者不必直接修改DeepSeek Harness原始碼。 AI代理除了需要模型負責理解指令與產生回應，也需要一套執行機制，才能操作檔案、呼叫工具或持續處理任務。DeepSeek Harness負責將模型連接到實際工作環境，並管理工具使用、檔案操作、工作階段及沙箱等功能。

items_all.title: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items_all.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index That's the same score as GPT-5.6 Luna (max), and just one point behind GLM-5.2 (max) and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max) - that GLM is 753B and that DeepSeek is 1.6B parameters, and Luna is size unknown but presumably a whole lot bigger than 27B. Qwen 3.8 27B is a truly astonishing model . Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , ai-in-china , artificial-analysis
items_all.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 在人工智慧分析指數上得分為 52，與 GPT-5.6 Luna（最大值）得分相同，僅落後 GLM-5.2（最大值）和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813（最大值）一分 - GLM 為 753B，DeepSeek 為 1.6B 參數，Luna 大小未知，但可能比 27B 大很多。 Qwen 3.8 27B 是一款真正令人驚歎的型號。來自 Hacker News 標籤： 人工智慧 , 生成人工智慧 , llms , qwen , 人工智慧在中國 , 人工分析

items_all.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
items_all.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books. Tags: amazon , journalism , ai , training-data , ai-ethics , 404-media
items_all.summary_zh: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。結束於 亞馬遜 AI 培訓設施 404 Media 的精彩報道。一段時間以來，有一些故事稱，書商從顯然對價格不敏感的匿名客戶那裡收到了大量書籍的訂單，人們普遍懷疑這些公司希望掃描這些書籍進行人工智慧培訓（請參閱我之前從 2025 年 6 月開始對 Anthropic's 書籍掃描的報道。）404 Media 使用 AirTag 進行了調查！ 7 月，一位書商告訴我，他們在 Biblio（這些市場之一）上收到了大約 1,000 本書的大訂單。賣家同意將 404 Media 提供的 蘋果 AirTag 放入此訂單中包含的一本書中，以便我們可以瞭解該書的去向。進一步來說，是哪家公司（無論是人工智慧還是其他公司）支援了這一鉅額訂單。這本書最終被送到了拉斯維加斯東北部 LAS8 亞馬遜 設施的 VGT3 角落，那裡的入口處有一個恐龍和一本書的鼻子標誌！圖片來源：404 Media Online 論壇 亞馬遜 工作人員之間的討論證實，VGT3 會破壞性掃描大量書籍。標籤：亞馬遜、新聞、人工智慧、培訓資料、人工智慧倫理、404媒體

items_all_raw.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items_all_raw.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.title: MiniMax Releases MiniMax-Music3: An Open-Weights Music Model Generating Complete Five-Minute Songs From Lyrics and a Structured Caption
items_all_raw.summary: MiniMax released MiniMax-Music3, an open-weights text-to-music model. Given lyrics with section tags and a structured caption, it generates a complete song of up to five minutes in a single pass, as 32 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV. Here is the architecture, the three serving paths, and the license conditions that matter before you ship. items_all_raw.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
items_all_raw.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books. Tags: amazon , journalism , ai , training-data , ai-ethics , 404-media
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。結束於 亞馬遜 AI 培訓設施 404 Media 的精彩報道。一段時間以來，有一些故事稱，書商從顯然對價格不敏感的匿名客戶那裡收到了大量書籍的訂單，人們普遍懷疑這些公司希望掃描這些書籍進行人工智慧培訓（請參閱我之前從 2025 年 6 月開始對 Anthropic's 書籍掃描的報道。）404 Media 使用 AirTag 進行了調查！ 7 月，一位書商告訴我，他們在 Biblio（這些市場之一）上收到了大約 1,000 本書的大訂單。賣家同意將 404 Media 提供的 蘋果 AirTag 放入此訂單中包含的一本書中，以便我們可以瞭解該書的去向。進一步來說，是哪家公司（無論是人工智慧還是其他公司）支援了這一鉅額訂單。這本書最終被送到了拉斯維加斯東北部 LAS8 亞馬遜 設施的 VGT3 角落，那裡的入口處有一個恐龍和一本書的鼻子標誌！圖片來源：404 Media Online 論壇 亞馬遜 工作人員之間的討論證實，VGT3 會破壞性掃描大量書籍。標籤：亞馬遜、新聞、人工智慧、培訓資料、人工智慧倫理、404媒體

items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI has signed a 20-year lease for an 8-gigawatt data center in Ohio. Nvidia is guaranteeing up to $105 billion for the residual value of the facilities and becomes the exclusive chip supplier. According to the Wall Street Journal, nine tech companies now hold around $3 trillion in AI commitments that don't appear on any balance sheet. The article OpenAI signs record Ohio data center lease with Nvidia backing up to $105 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 已簽署俄亥俄州一座 8 吉瓦資料中心的 20 年租約。 Nvidia 為這些設施的剩餘價值提供高達 1050 億美元的保證，併成為獨家晶片供應商。據《華爾街日報》報道，九家科技公司目前持有約 3 萬億美元的人工智慧承諾，但這些承諾並未出現在任何資產負債表上。文章 OpenAI 與 Nvidia 簽訂了創紀錄的俄亥俄州資料中心租賃合同，金額高達 1050 億美元，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
items_all_raw.summary: AI production companies like Promise are setting up shop around Hollywood's historic studios, using real-time backgrounds and other AI tools to cut film costs. Netflix already uses AI in 300 of its 1,000 titles, and the startup Higgsfield now carries a $5.4 billion valuation. What was once a tech demo has grown into its own industry, complete with valuations, job titles, and fights over who gets a cut. The article AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 像 Promise 這樣的人工智慧製作公司正在好萊塢歷史悠久的工作室周圍設立工作室，使用實時背景和其他人工智慧工具來削減電影成本。 Netflix 已在其 1,000 部作品中的 300 部中使用了人工智慧，初創公司 Higgsfield 目前估值為 54 億美元。曾經的技術演示已經發展成為自己的行業，包括估值、職位頭銜以及對誰能獲得提成的爭論。 《AI 影片市場已從 Sora's 錯誤開始中反彈》一文首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.summary: Google宣佈將讓使用者自行決定以Gemini生成的圖片、影片和音樂移除明顯的浮水印，但仍然保有機器可辨識的數位痕跡。Google同時開源用以開發內容驗證的C++函式庫Credentio。 使用者可在「設定」區中關閉「Show watermark（顯示浮水印）」設定，就能為所有Gemini模型生成的圖片、影片和音樂關閉可見的浮水印，但是人眼不可見的SynthID浮水印和C2PA meta仍然會保留嵌入於背景。Google將在未來幾天內部署這項新設定。

items_all_raw.title: AI and data centers have leapfrogged Israel, racism, and crypto as US campaign topics
items_all_raw.summary: AI shows up in nearly 40 percent of all US races, ranking ahead of Israel, racism, and manufacturing as a campaign topic. Data centers and their impact on electricity costs and local resources drive most of the conversation. The article AI and data centers have leapfrogged Israel, racism, and crypto as US campaign topics appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items_all_raw.summary: According to Bloomberg, Stripe is acquiring the AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, up from a latest valuation of $1.3 billion. OpenRouter offers access to over 400 AI models, has eight million users, and its CEO had described the company as "Stripe for AI." Now that's becoming a reality. The article Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 據彭博社報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter，高於最新估值 13 億美元。 OpenRouter 提供對 400 多種 AI 模型的訪問，擁有 800 萬使用者，其執行長將該公司描述為“AI 的 Stripe”。現在這正在成為現實。據報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: 不動產登記案件增、人力不足! 竹市導入AI協審半年處理逾2千案件，省下逾3萬分鐘工時
items_all_raw.summary: 隨著不動產交易需求增加，地政事務所長期面臨案件量增加與審查人力不足的雙重壓力。過去土地登記案件多以紙本送件為主，審查人員需逐項核對身分證、印鑑證明、契約書及完稅資料等文件，在少子化及公務人力補充不易的環境下，如何利用科技提升行政審查效率，成為政府導入AI的重要應用場景。 以新竹市地政事務所為例，因竹科帶動的房地產交易需求增加，不動產登記案件量長期居全國單一地政事務所前幾名，以2025年辦理的不動產登記案件就多達16萬4,653筆之多，連續三年稱霸全國單一地政事務所冠軍。 若以買賣案件為例，審查人員每個案件需要跨文件核對至少約95個欄位，涉及多份紙本文件，過去主要仰賴承辦人員人工比對。

items_all_raw.title: DeepSeek開源DeepSeek Harness，AI代理執行環境可拆成外掛自由組合
items_all_raw.summary: DeepSeek開源AI代理執行框架DeepSeek Harness，目前以開發者預覽版提供使用。框架底層採用Cordis外掛（Plugin）系統，從AI模型、工具、技能、工作階段、沙箱、儲存、代理執行迴圈、排程到使用者介面，都能依需求更換或重新組合，開發者不必直接修改DeepSeek Harness原始碼。 AI代理除了需要模型負責理解指令與產生回應，也需要一套執行機制，才能操作檔案、呼叫工具或持續處理任務。DeepSeek Harness負責將模型連接到實際工作環境，並管理工具使用、檔案操作、工作階段及沙箱等功能。
